svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Production stack: Core: TypeScript, Node.js, Python, Go, NestJS, Fastify, React, Next.js. Data: PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis, SQLite. AI: Anthropic, Agent SDK, MCP, OpenAI. Ops & Security: Docker, Linux, Caddy, Authelia, CrowdSec, Actions, Trivy, Semgrep, Gitleaks. Integrations: WhatsApp, Telegram, PIX, Google Maps, ERP.
